lost-ack.scope: Real successful WAL sync; parent SIGKILL before application acknowledgement. Not physical power loss.

sync-error-no-close.scope: Real successful WAL sync returns EIO; application receives error, parent kills before close, fresh process determines outcome. Not physical power loss.

scope: Named commit/refusal/rollback contracts plus two real successful-WAL-sync/process-death boundaries; not arbitrary device faults or physical power loss
